prompt: Compare total attributed revenue from campaigns vs flows over the last 30 days. You will need to pull both campaign reports and flow reports and sum the revenue across each. Put the answer inside `final_answer` as a JSON array containing a single object with fields: campaigns_revenue, flows_revenue, winner. The `winner` field must be either the string "campaigns" or the string "flows".

claims.description: object has both revenue totals and a winner

claims.expected: The winner field correctly identifies which channel had higher revenue based on the two numeric fields in the same object.
claims.description: winner matches the larger revenue side

notes: Stresses two reporting endpoints + aggregation. Judge claim verifies the comparison was made correctly.
